title: ADR 0006 markdown doc: deliveries module + polymorphic UX
body_md: Many ledger tasks reference 'ADR 0006' (deliveries module, artifact storage, pusher contract, vacuum GC) but docs/adr/ has no 0006 file. File docs/adr/0006-deliveries-module.md capturing the polymorphic deliveries decision, alternatives weighed, and consequences. Single commit. Per U-0008 this anchor reading is what unblocks newcomers reading the chain of adr-0006-* tasks.
